tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: Find astockevent acquisitions by name, verified ticker/alias or CIK; not all-market search.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description:
Read source mentions by filing date (YYYY-MM-DD), including coverage and qualifiers.

        Omit build for current results; explicit build requests historical results.
        Repeated mentions are not newly occurring events or notification changes.

tools.name: get_passage
tools.description: Read a citation returned by the selected deal, with neighbouring source paragraphs.

tools.name: list_earnings_companies
tools.description:
Find saved earnings by name, verified ticker or CIK, not all-market coverage.

        Same-period source mentions are not distinct new earnings.

tools.name: get_earnings
get_earnings_passage
tools.description:
Read a current earnings citation and neighbours for this CIK.

        Same-period source mentions are not distinct new earnings.

tools.name: list_leadership_companies
tools.description:
Find saved executive/board disclosures by name, verified ticker or CIK.

        This is a processed subset, not all-market coverage or a current officer roster.

tools.name: get_leadership
tools.description:
Read executive/board source mentions for a ten-digit registrant CIK.

        preserve role, employer, interim status, conditions and date qualifiers.

tools.name: get_leadership_passage
tools.description:
Read a current leadership citation and neighbours for this registrant CIK.
